name: sdd-solo
description: Spec-Driven Development for one developer + an AI: the four layers BR/UC/Entity/AC, a Definition of Ready gate before any code, an adversarial pass instead of a reviewer, Claude Design as an official step, BPMN/DMN/Mermaid at every layer, and a two-level design layer (architecture.md for the project, design.md per UC). It runs the whole way round on its own — the only mandatory dependencies are git, bash and node.
